sentence_stem: Although I am very busy this week,
correct_completion: I will reply to your letter next Monday.
full_sentence: Although I am very busy this week, I will reply to your letter next Monday.
acceptable_variants: I will still answer your letter soon.
I will write back as soon as possible.

options.text: so I will not reply to your letter.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, which does not fit the contrast introduced by 'although'.

options.text: I will reply to your letter next Monday.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' shows a cause, but the stem already uses 'although', which signals contrast.
This describes a letter, not an action that contrasts with being busy.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners sometimes add a result or cause clause here, which breaks the contrast pattern.
translation: Embora eu esteja muito ocupado esta semana, responderei à sua carta na próxima segunda-feira.
